title: Pak Choi Quiche
description: A Japanese-inspired quiche recipe featuring pak choi and quiet ingredients.

ingredients.name: Quiche Crust
ingredients.notes: You can use a homemade crust if you prefer

instructions: Roll out the quiche crust and place it in a pie dish.
In a pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat. Add the pak choi and cook until wilted.
In a blender, combine the silken tofu, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Pour the tofu mixture into the pie crust and top with the cooked pak choi.
Sprinkle the cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
